isolation: Use per-task stack and synthetic data only; do not send messages or contact real applicants

scenarios.title: Domain boundaries
scenarios.given: Records with every enum and Unicode boundary fixture
scenarios.when: Create with valid values, at limit and one beyond; submit client status/date; read publicly
scenarios.then: Valid records persist with server AVAILABLE/UTC; invalid fields reject with 400; code-point counts match UI; no private fields appear
scenarios.method: DTO validation, API and mapper tests

scenarios.title: Stale updates and deletion
scenarios.given: Two staff clients share an ETag and a separate stone has an active hold
scenarios.when: Save from both clients; omit If-Match; attempt deletion of held and free stones
scenarios.then: First save succeeds, stale requests return 412, missing preconditions return 428, active hold returns 409; valid delete hides the stone and preserves tombstone/cleanup intent

scenarios.title: Upload validation and ownership
scenarios.given: Authorized staff plus a foreign staff session and visitors
scenarios.when: Upload supported files at 10 MiB and over, MIME/signature mismatch, corrupt/animated/oversized-pixel files and metadata-bearing image
scenarios.then: Only valid bounded decoded images accepted; metadata removed; private keys hidden; foreign draft returns 404; unauthorized upload returns 401/403
scenarios.method: File-security integration fixtures and authorization tests

scenarios.title: Atomic create and lost response
scenarios.given: Sixteen owned drafts and two concurrent creators
scenarios.when: Create at expiry boundary, reuse/duplicate references, race claims and drop the successful HTTP response
scenarios.then: One atomic winner; expired/duplicate/foreign cases fail without partial stone; same-key replay gives original result; changed payload returns 409; valid drafts survive confirmed rollback
scenarios.method: Database race, clock and fault-injection tests

scenarios.title: Photo repair and cleanup
scenarios.given: A new stone has one failed permanent copy and retained source
scenarios.when: Restart worker through retry schedule, repair storage, exhaust a second photo, manually retry and remove a pending photo
scenarios.then: Saved stone survives; states/retry count persist; ready URL appears only after copy; cleanup never deletes an attached sole copy and eventually removes detached bytes
scenarios.method: Isolated MinIO integration with controlled clock

scenarios.title: Usable create workflow
scenarios.when: Select mixed valid/invalid batches, reorder, remove cover, fail one upload, retry creation and choose Add another
scenarios.then: Progressive previews/counts/order are correct; successful drafts retained; fields/errors/focus preserved; no duplicate POST; confirmation and fresh form work
scenarios.method: Playwright real API with isolated uploads

scenarios.title: URL expiry and contracts
scenarios.given: READY and PENDING photos with controllable signed-link expiry
scenarios.when: Read detail/draft, expire URL and refresh; inspect serialized representations
scenarios.then: Only READY has a URL; refresh bounded once; no permanent signed URL storage; response fields/enums/nullability conform to generated schema
scenarios.method: API contract tests and browser expiry case

scenarios.title: Write uncertainty and replay window
scenarios.given: Saved create/application/reindex outcomes and retained key markers
scenarios.when: Retry identical/changed payloads before 72 hours and after 72 hours; simulate lost commit acknowledgement
scenarios.then: Original result replays without new work; changed/expired-used keys return 409; uncertainty reconciled before a new mutation; no assumed rollback

scenarios.title: Environment loss during integration
scenarios.given: A requested batch with declared components and isolated endpoints
scenarios.when: Stop a required database, API or browser dependency between precheck and completion; change content after a passing run
scenarios.then: The batch starts only after every prerequisite passes; the watcher detects loss and marks BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; changed content invalidates evidence; original application data is untouched

implementation: Each browser-required ticket creates its own executable quality/e2e/<TASK-ID>/*.spec.ts suite for that ticket contribution; full scenarios are aggregated at release
